text: This report recommends the appointment of 1 public member to the Heritage Toronto Board of Directors.

City Council on July 19, 20, 21 and 22, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Anne Deck to the Heritage Toronto Board of Directors, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on February 4, 2024. 2. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 9, 2022) from the City Clerk remain confidential as it relates to personal matters about an identifiable individual being considered for appointment to the Heritage Toronto Board of Directors. The balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 9, 2022) from the City Clerk remains confidential in its entirety in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, as it relates to personal matters about an identifiable individual being considered for appointment to the Heritage Toronto Board of Directors.
